snippet.description:
In this video, AIR 87 Sayali shares how she approached her UPSC Mains preparation and the notes she followed during this phase. She explains how question-answer based notes, Previous Year Questions (PYQs), data, introductions, examples and concise subject-wise notes helped her prepare for Mains.

She also discusses how the Mains Master Program (MMP) at LevelUp IAS supported her preparation through structured, question-answer based notes, classroom question discussions and subject-specific value addition. She shares how Santosh Kumar Sir's guidance on data, PYQs and current affairs integration, along with concise notes provided during MMP, helped her approach different GS subjects.

For UPSC aspirants, the focus should be on creating notes that are easy to revise, connected to PYQs, useful for answer writing and aligned with the UPSC Mains syllabus.

Watch this video to understand how AIR 87 approached UPSC Mains notes, revision, answer writing and Mains preparation with LevelUp IAS Mains Master Program.
